truncation.marker: [... tool output truncated: {dropped} of {original} chars dropped; head and tail kept, full text is in the episode's raw event log ...]
truncation.applies_to: sample.messages only; episode.jsonl keeps the full verbatim output

function.name: read
function.description: Reads a file with line numbers. If the path is a directory it returns the directory structure instead. Default limit is 2000 lines; long lines and 200KB+ files are cut with an explicit marker telling you where to continue.

file_path.description: Absolute path to read (preferred). Relative paths resolve against the working directory.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (0-indexed).

limit.description: Number of lines to read. Default 2000.

function.name: glob
function.description: Searches for files by gitignore-style glob pattern (requires ripgrep). Returns paths relative to the search directory, most recently modified first; respects .gitignore and excludes VCS and dependency directories.

pattern.description: Glob pattern matched against paths relative to the search directory (e.g. '**/*.test.ts').

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the working directory.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return. Default 100, max 500.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search tool built on ripgrep. Full regex syntax; literal braces need escaping. Output modes: files_with_matches (default), content, count. Supports context lines, pagination and file type filtering.

path.description: File or directory to search in. Use absolute paths.

context.description: Lines before and after each match; overrides the separate options.

offset.description: Skip this many results for pagination.

function.name: edit
function.description: Performs exact string replacements in files and can create new files. Provide file_path + old_string + new_string to replace, file_path + new_string with an empty old_string to create, or file_path + edits for a sequential multi-edit. Whitespace must match exactly.

file_path.description: Absolute path to modify or create.

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Leave empty to create a new file. Mutually exclusive with edits.

new_string.description: Replacement text, or the full content when creating.

start_line.description: 1-based start line that narrows the search scope.

end_line.description: 1-based end line that narrows the search scope.

edits.description: Edit operations applied sequentially. Mutually exclusive with old_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence in this edit.

function.name: write
function.description: Writes content to a file, creating it if needed or overwriting it if it exists.

function.name: bash
function.description: Executes a bash command. Runs synchronously by default and returns stdout/stderr. Set background=true to run it in the background and return immediately with a task id (use this for long installs/tests). Never use sleep or polling loops to implement a delayed or recurring request.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000). Default 120000. Ignored when background=true.

background.description: Run in the background and return immediately with a task id.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in 5-10 words.

function.name: todo_write
function.description: Creates and manages the structured task list for the session. Always send the FULL list. Only one task should be in_progress at a time.

function.name: todoread
function.description: Returns the current todo list for the session.
